deviceEvents.heading: Device events
deviceEvents.note: Dated reports imported from DiscoCan: the unit's eData fault logger, CAN errors and switches to Karma's backup server. They are not alerts: nobody acknowledges or resolves them, and a cleared code does not prove a repair.

edata.heading: eData observations · last 24 h
edata.note: Dots show raw hex-byte magnitudes for engine speed, fuel level and coolant temperature IDs. No interpolation; byte order, scale and physical units are not yet verified.
edata.truncated: Only the newest 2,000 observations in this range are shown.
edata.empty: No imported observations for these IDs in this period.

profile.moduleInfo: The vehicle profile brings together device readings, trips, problems and maintenance history. Recorded fault evidence is historical, and raw eData observations have unverified units and scaling. Commands and SMS belong to the selected installed device. Authorized users can edit vehicle details and record a manual odometer reading.

odometer.title: Record odometer · {plate}
odometer.description: Record a manual reading. It updates the odometer only; activity and the data clock stay unchanged.
odometer.inactive: Manual readings are unavailable for inactive vehicles.
odometer.noTimeInterval: No later reading time is available yet. Wait for newer vehicle data, then reopen this form.
odometer.lowerReading: The odometer cannot be lower than the latest reading.
odometer.earlierReading: Use a time after the latest odometer reading of this vehicle.
odometer.futureReading: The reading cannot be later than the latest vehicle data or now.
odometer.dateRange: Use a reading time from 2000-01-01 through 2100-12-31 in UTC.
odometer.saveError: The reading could not be saved. Try again.

moduleInfo: Vehicles shows the fleet, installed devices and their live reporting status. You can search and filter vehicles, inspect their history and maintain vehicle details according to your role. An inactive vehicle remains in the history; its device status is shown separately. Summary counts cover the displayed rows and current warning lamps.
